title: Hold a run until its route can answer input
description: A route of a run the daemon accepted could not answer at the submit: the gateway is ready and lists the alias, and the status of the model (`callable` of `GET /v1/status`, else the phase of `GET /v1/models/{alias}/status` for a managed or a local route) says it cannot take a call now. The run is WaitingForRoute: no call goes to the route and nothing is woken. The daemon reads the status at most once every 5 seconds of its clock, up to the route's `start_wait_seconds` (none declared: no wait); once every route of the run can answer, the runtime starts it (StartRun); past the wait the daemon ends it (EndRouteWait). The daemon also writes the run event `runbook.waiting-for-route` (record: route, phase, wait_seconds); see CancelRun for why it is stated here. Issued by the daemon itself (actor DaemonProcess): it has no route in the HTTP contract.

phase.description: The phase the gateway gave of the route's model.

sdc.daemon.RunId.title: RunId
sdc.daemon.RunId.description: The id of a run. The daemon mints it (a UUID, version 7) in the HTTP handler and returns it in the answer to the submit; the handler fills the `run_id` input of SubmitRun and a client never chooses it. The state directory of the run is named after it. A run id that is already taken cannot occur, because the daemon mints it; the specification has no refusal for it.
